claims.statement: Expand the initiative beyond the original narrow time annotation seed into a broader chart annotation capability.
Create and edit labels, callouts, arrows, targets, bands, ranges, events, geometric regions, and saved record highlights on live charts.
claims.notes: Recommended scope, not a claim that the user individually approved each form.

claims.statement: Keep record, coordinate, plot-position, record-set, and derived attachments distinct through filtering and data updates.

claims.statement: Internal row IDs are array indices. Stable record attachments need explicit unique source keys and visible missing/ambiguous states.
Prove a record callout and fixed target together; the first slice does not limit the complete annotation scope.

Evaluate freehand, images, snapping, presets, automatic placement, and bulk events without making them prerequisites for core annotation authoring.

themes: Broad scope delivered in useful slices

conflicts.older_interpretation: A fixed line first, with broader references deferred until that narrow seed proves useful.
conflicts.resolution: The user explicitly expanded the initiative. A record callout plus fixed target is now the first proof inside a broader authoring capability.

shape.appetite: A coherent annotation capability across supported Cartesian charts, delivered in useful slices; no invented time budget.
shape.problem: Users cannot author a consistent set of saved, meaningful annotations on ordinary charts without custom rendering work.
shape.recommended_shape: Small application-owned saved annotations, explicit attachment semantics, current renderer projections, compact editing controls, existing host history, and reuse of composition behavior.

counterproposal.proposal: Add only a fixed target line to the settings.
counterproposal.reason: It does not satisfy the explicit broader direction or test record identity and editing. Keep a fixed target as one part of the first proof.

success_moves.move: Pair a record callout with a fixed target in the first proof.
success_moves.benefit: Tests the two meanings most likely to be conflated before more geometry is added.

success_moves.move: Resolve unique source keys before projection.
success_moves.benefit: Prevents reordered replacement rows from inheriting an unrelated annotation.

success_moves.move: Reuse composition controls and the chart edit transaction.
success_moves.benefit: Avoids a second history authority and duplicate artboard editing.

success_moves.move: Keep deterministic row and scale fixtures local.
success_moves.benefit: Missing, duplicate, filtered, and invalid values can be tested without a service.

success_moves.move: Add one chart host at a time and keep export ownership explicit.
success_moves.benefit: Limits projection collisions and prevents an unbuilt output path from being marked complete.

first_proof.question: Can authored content follow a stable record while a fixed reference stays fixed, through editing, filtering, replacement, and saving?
first_proof.artifact: Planned synthetic keyed-data scatter example plus focused resolver, serialization, and edit-transaction checks; no implementation produced in this update.
first_proof.observation: Same source key after reorder; label movement preserves attachment; fixed value remains constant; missing/duplicate keys show repair state; one host history step per commit.
first_proof.decision_rule: Proceed to more forms only after those checks pass. If identity or projection fails, repair that boundary without replacing the broader scope with target-only scope.

milestones.title: A note stays attached to the same observation
milestones.outcome: Keyed record callouts and fixed targets save, restore, and edit correctly.
milestones.proof: Reorder/change/delete/duplicate keys; filter; resize; reload; cancel and undo in local scatter.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: A usable ordinary scatter annotation flow.
milestones.rollback: Remove or hide the optional annotation; underlying scatter stays unchanged.
evidence: Scatter callouts and reference lines: src/lib/annotations/resolve.test.ts (key reorder, missing, duplicate, symlog, filtered), components/charts/annotations/annotations.test.tsx (drag = one host change, Escape cancels, keyboard nudge, Notes tab add). Browser check on /examples/bubble-scatter: one drag = one undo step, typed label = one undo step, Baseline filter hides the Day 31 callout and lists it as Filtered out. pnpm check passed.

milestones.title: Users can explain values, events, and intervals
milestones.outcome: Fixed references, callouts, arrows, bands, ranges, category/date attachments, and supplied bounds work on scatter and line charts.
milestones.proof: Check both line paths, dual axes, dates, symlog, missing/reversed bounds, forms, and save/restore.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Useful multi-form authoring on two chart families.
milestones.rollback: Remove the new form without changing the chart data or earlier annotation forms.
evidence: Line and time-series annotations, bands/brackets, supplied intervals, right axis, date inputs, duplicate/name, chart-reported statuses. Tests: resolve.test.ts (bands, intervals, right axis, unsupported records), lineAnnotations.test.tsx (series callout on right axis, band, interval ribbon, time-series event). Screenshots of product-activity and calendar-series examples at 1280/390. pnpm check passed.

milestones.title: Highlights and derived references retain their meaning
milestones.outcome: Record sets, geometric regions, and scoped calculations have distinct filter behavior.
milestones.proof: Filter sets partially; remove keys; change the query winner; confirm no history steps from filtering.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Live annotations explain groups and calculated comparisons.
milestones.rollback: Remove the region or derived reference; fixed annotations remain valid.

milestones.title: Supported charts and compositions share consistent annotation behavior
milestones.outcome: More Cartesian charts and compositions reuse proven annotation behavior.
milestones.proof: Check group/bin identity, facets, field changes, and an existing composition round trip.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Each supported chart advertises only attachment kinds it can resolve.
milestones.rollback: Revert the added host integration without converting saved compositions.

milestones.title: Annotated graphics remain useful when saved and shared
milestones.outcome: Persistence, dashboard text, keyboard management, and image export preserve annotations.
milestones.proof: Full-analysis/host echo round trips; inspect actual output; keyboard and focus checks at required widths.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: The complete proposed core scope saves and shares correctly on supported charts.
milestones.rollback: Disable the affected output action while preserving saved annotations; keep the milestone open.

cut_line: Freehand, images, automatic layout, advanced snapping, presets, and bulk events require evaluation.
